0: SELECT CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_rate FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.`CDSCode` = T2.`CDSCode` WHERE T2.`County` = 'Alameda'	----- bird -----	california_schools
1: SELECT CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_rate FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.`CDSCode` = T2.`CDSCode` WHERE T2.`StatusType` = 'Continuation' AND T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL AND T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` != 0 ORDER BY eligible_rate ASC LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
2: SELECT T1.`Zip` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.`CDSCode` = T2.`CDSCode` WHERE T2.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND T2.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
3: SELECT T1.`MailStreet` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.`CDSCode` = T2.`CDSCode` ORDER BY T2.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
4: SELECT DISTINCT s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'	----- bird -----	california_schools
5: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.School) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' AND T2.AvgScrMath > 400	----- bird -----	california_schools
6: SELECT DISTINCT s.School FROM schools s INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode INNER JOIN satscores sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE s.`Magnet` = 1 OR sc.NumGE1500 > 500	----- bird -----	california_schools
7: SELECT schools.Phone FROM schools INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds AND satscores.NumGE1500 = 1 ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
